3725.text: In an agricultural field, which among the following is the highest producer of methane?
3725.sol: Rice is grown in flooded fields, a situation that depletes the soil of oxygen. Soils that are anaerobic (lacking oxygen) allow the bacteria that produce methane from decomposing organic matter to thrive. Some of this methane then bubbles to the surface, but most of it is diffused back into the atmosphere through the rice plants themselves. Hence, rice Paddy field that produces maximum methane gas into the atmosphere. Hence, option (b) is correct.

71012.subject: Biology
71012.text: If in a person, the trachea and bronchi of the respiratory system do not have tracheal rings, then which of the following would be the result?
options: Air flows smoothly from and to lungs
71012.sol: The trachea and bronchi are supported by incomplete C-shaped cartilaginous rings. These rings provide structural support and prevent the airways from collapsing during inspiration when the pressure inside the respiratory tract decreases. 71816.subject: Chemistry
71816.text: The dihedral angle in the staggered conformation of CH ₃ CH ₃ is
71816.sol: In the staggered conformation of ethane ( CH ₃ CH ₃ ), the hydrogen atoms on adjacent carbon atoms are positioned as far apart as possible to minimize torsional strain. This arrangement results in a dihedral angle of 60^ between the adjacent C-H bonds. Answer: 60^

Among these elements, Radium ( Ra ) is the only naturally occurring radioactive alkaline earth metal. Cesium ( Cs ), Rubidium ( Rb ), and Francium ( Fr ) are alkali metals (Group 1), with Francium being the radioactive alkali metal. Answer: Ra

74123.sol: A hotspot is a natural habitat that has at least more than 0.5 % of total vascular plants as endemic species and is under threat by human activities. 128947.sol: Heart failure means the state of heart when it is not pumping blood effectively enough to meet the needs of the body. Expiratory reserve volume, tidal volume, and inspiratory reserve volume
129849.sol: Inspiratory Capacity (IC): Total volume of air a person can inspire after a normal expiration. This includes tidal volume and inspiratory reserve volume ( TV+IRV). Expiratory Capacity (EC): Total volume of air a person can expire after a normal inspiration. This includes tidal volume and expiratory reserve volume (TV+ERV). 130787.subject: Zoology
130787.text: Amniocentesis is a medical procedure used to test for the presence of certain genetic disorders based on the chromosomal pattern in the amniotic fluid. Which of the following conditions cannot be detected using this technique?
130787.sol: Amniocentesis is based on the chromosomal pattern in the amniotic fluid surrounding the developing embryo. Jaundice is a physiological condition (often related to liver function or bilirubin metabolism) and not a genetic disorder detectable by chromosomal analysis of fetal cells. Answer: Jaundice

133730.sol: Alexander Fleming while working on Staphylococci bacteria, once observed a mould growing in one of his unwashed culture plates around which Staphylococci could not grow. He found out that it was due to a chemical produced by the mould and he named it Penicillin after the mould Penicillium notatum. 134351.subject: Zoology
134351.text: What might be an advantage of beginning gene therapy prior to birth?

The body would not reject it as it has not yet recognised 'self'.
The cells being extremely young, are more receptive to gene therapy.
Probably there is not any advantage.
134351.sol: There are great advances in the identification and construction of genes but attempts at inserting them and coaxing them to function normally within human body have not been successful. Recognition of 'self' and 'foreign' is not developed at this stage.

95707.subject: Botany
95707.text: Which of the following statements is true according to the concept of biological classification?
options: Bacteria are heterotrophic saprophytic organisms in the kingdom Monera with a great range of diversity.
The heterotrophic prokaryotic, multicellular organisms lacking a cell wall are included in kingdom Animalia.
Kingdom Fungi includes eukaryotic, multicellular heterotrophic organisms which exhibit both sexual as well as
Kingdom Plantae includes eukaryotic chlorophyll containing unicellular organisms and a few heterotrophs.
95707.sol: Bacteria may be autotrophic or heterotrophic organisms with a wide range of diversity present in the kingdom Monera. Members of kingdom Fungi are heterotrophic, eukaryotic, multicellular organism with cell wall made of chitin and exhibit both sexual as well as asexual modes of reproduction. Organisms present in kingdom Animalia are eukaryotic, multicellular, and heterotrophic with no cell wall. Kingdom Plantae consists of eukaryotic chlorophyll containing organisms with few heterotrophs.

95721.subject: Botany
95721.text: Identify the correct sequence with respect to the growth of slime moulds.
options: Slime moulds → unfavourable conditions → plasmodium → favourable conditions → spore formation
Slime moulds → favourable conditions → spore formation → unfavourable conditions → plasmodium
Slime moulds → favourable conditions → plasmodium → unfavourable conditions → spore formation
Slime moulds → unfavourable conditions → spore formation → favourable conditions → plasmodium
95721.sol: Slime moulds are saprophytic protists. In suitable conditions these organisms form an aggregation called plasmodium which again differentiates during unfavorable conditions and form fruiting bodies, bearing spores at their tips. These spores have true walls and are extremely resistant to any adverse conditions, making their survival easy.

98814.text: What type of intermolecular forces exist between N H 3 and C 6 H 6 ?
options: Dipole-induced dipole forces and dispersion forces
98814.sol: N H 3 is polar and C 6 H 6 is non-polar. N H 3 molecule, being a dipole, induces a dipole in the non-polar C 6 H 6 molecule. Dipole-induced dipole forces exist among the molecule of N H 3 and C 6 H 6 . Since dispersion forces exist among species of any type, therefore, dispersion forces also exist. Hence, forces are dipole-induced dipole force and dispersion forces.

306454.sol: The electric field produced by a point charge Q is an electrostatic field, which is conservative in nature.
